item.title: Public media adapts after losing federal funding: rage-giving, innovation, and cuts
item.description: One year after federal funding for public media ended, stations are reinventing themselves through innovation, cuts, and donor-driven support.

item.title: Displaced Lebanese use satellite images to check on their homes
item.description: Unable to return, some Lebanese displaced by Israel's invasion are buying satellite photos to see if their houses survived the conflict.

item.title: U.S. and Iran both pause attacks for a second consecutive day
item.description: The United States and Iran both halted military strikes for a second day on Sunday, as diplomatic efforts to de-escalate continued.
